Name: Fattening Curvy Girl
Author: GoddessVirtue
Description:
This is a compatibility pack for the Fattening Farmer Framework.
In order to get this pack running, first make sure you have SMAPI and the Fattening Farmer Framework installed.
Place this pack's main folder, "[CP] FatteningCurvyGirl" in your Mods folder, within your Stardew Valley install folder.
Then, download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32338]Curvy Girl Redux[/url] by onlyonechris and silvermoonchan from https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32338.
Extract Curvy Girl Redux and put the main folder, "Curvy Girl Redux", inside Fattening Curvy Girl's main folder.
And you're done!

Bonus feature: This mod supports the GenericModConfigMenu by spacechase0.
If you also have GenericModConfigMenu installed, you'll be able to configure this mod from inside your game.
Just hit the gear icon from the main menu.

Thank you to onlyonechris and silvermoonchan for allowing this compatibility pack to be released!
